entries.description: Free, open-source (MIT) Android app that records video in the background with the screen off. Tap once, lock the phone, and a foreground service keeps recording; stop it in the app, from the notification or automatically after 5–60 minutes. Recordings are saved as MP4 to Movies/XCam. The app requests no internet permission. Android 13+, 64-bit ARM, distributed as a signed APK.
